summary: Type a message and send it in Morse code with the front light.
release_notes: Rebuilt on a renderer that keeps every control reachable at the largest text sizes, and on a keyboard that can type every character this app asks for.
user: Somebody who wants to send a message in Morse with the front light.
job: Type a message and watch the front light blink it in Morse.
offline: It never touches the network; the light is the whole show.

capabilities_required.name: frontlight-control
capabilities_required.purpose: to blink your message on the front light

non_goals: It does not save your messages.
